newsitem.title: CHINA: Belgium's Kredietbank to open Shanghai branch.
newsitem.headline: Belgium's Kredietbank to open Shanghai branch.

text.p: China's central bank has agreed to allow Belgium's Kredietbank upgrade its representative office in Shanghai into a full-fledged branch, Belgian Vice-Premier Philippe Maystadt said on Wednesday.

"KB was granted a licence by the People's Bank of China for opening a new branch in Shanghai allowing an upgrade of its current representation office into full-fledged branch," Maystadt told a news conference in Beijing.
Maystadt was part of a 210-member Belgian economic delegation which arrived in China on Monday for a 12-day visit.
